lines.zh: 我扇着小翅膀，悬着往前挪
lines.en: I beat tiny wings and drift forward.

lines.zh: 我飞得不高，就在草尖上面
lines.en: I fly low, just above the grass.

lines.zh: 我的身体很小，一只手就能托住
lines.en: I am small enough to hold in one hand.

lines.zh: 我落在草叶上，又飞起来
lines.en: I land on a blade of grass, then lift.

lines.zh: 我在同伴之间穿来穿去
lines.en: I weave between my companions.

lines.zh: 我摔不下来，翅膀一直扑
lines.en: I cannot fall; my wings never stop.
I drift toward wherever there is food.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比身体长一点
lines.en: My tail is a little longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我飞过一片平野，风很稳
lines.en: I cross an open field; the wind is steady.
I fly low along the flowers.
I watch you as I fly.
One turn and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我停在枝头，翅膀还在动
lines.en: I rest on a twig, wings still working.
My belly is round and full.
I wait for the next bite.
I come up to your shin.

lines.zh: 我还不会用翅膀做别的
lines.en: I cannot do more with my wings yet.
I huddle in a crowd of my companions.
My scales are still soft.
I burp.

lines.zh: 我数着树下有几只虫在叫
lines.en: I count the insects calling under the trees.
There are a dozen of me in this flock.

lines.zh: 我把头歪到另一边再看
lines.en: I tilt my head the other way to look.
A gust comes and I wobble.
I am waiting to grow.
I blow a bubble at the water.
I hover before you and look up.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我要飞高一点
lines.en: You are too tall; I will fly a little higher.

lines.zh: 我停在你鼻子前面的半空
lines.en: I hover a hand's width from your nose.
I am not afraid; I am too curious.
What is that in your hand?
I land on your shoulder.
I lift off and circle you once.
You reach out, and I dodge.
I chirp softly once.
My whole flock is watching you.
Stand still for now.
I come close, then pull back.
My tail touched you.

lines.zh: 我不会咬人，我的牙太小
lines.en: I do not bite; my teeth are too small.
What are you smiling at?
I land on the back of your hand.
I tumbled once and steadied.
I cry out twice from the pain.

lines.zh: 我拍得歪歪扭扭，落下来
lines.en: I flap crookedly and drop down.
I drop to the ground and curl up.
I am small and I fear pain.
My companions gather around.
I lift again, unsteadily.
My little life runs out fast.
I hide deep in the grass.

lines.zh: 我躲进草丛，还回头看你
lines.en: I hide in the grass and still look back at you.
Is that young-stage feed?
I smell it; I want it.

lines.zh: 我飞得很快，怕被别人抢
lines.en: I fly fast, afraid another will take it.
I peck at it bite by bite.
Not enough for my whole flock.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就飞上去
lines.en: Raise it and I will fly up.

lines.zh: 我叼了一口就飞到树上
lines.en: I take a bite and fly to the tree.
My whiskers are covered in crumbs.
Once full, I stop moving.
A little more; I am still small.
My companions are all flying over.

lines.zh: 我护着这一口，不给你们
lines.en: I guard this bite from the others.
You touched me and I tumbled.
I am knocked into a somersault.
I steady my wings and land on the grass.
I spun several circles before stopping.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻到你的另一侧
lines.en: The hit flipped me to your other side.
My flock scattered.

lines.zh: 我又飞回来，落在你肩上
lines.en: I fly back and land on your shoulder.
That was light, but sudden.
I shake and smooth my feathers.
Being shoved about is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我们还小，这个以后再说
lines.en: We are young; later.
Everyone in the flock is about the same age.
I can only follow along in flight.
Only after evolving could that be.
We sleep huddled together.
One companion always follows me.

lines.zh: 我们互相啄掉身上的土
lines.en: We pick the dirt off each other's scales.
I do not quite understand this.
Flying together is less frightening.
It is dark; let us sleep first.
I hug it with both forepaws.
This is larger than all of me.
Carrying it, I cannot fly high.
I drop it and dive after it.
I wobble along holding it.
Two chews and I spat it all out.
I put it in the grass nest.

lines.zh: 它在我爪子下面滚了半圈
lines.en: It rolled half a turn in my claws.
I trade it with a companion.
I let go, and it falls.
There is food smell over there.
Let me see what it is.
I climb to the height of the treetops.
That does not look edible.

lines.zh: 它比我的整个身体还高
lines.en: It stands taller than all of me.
I am a little nervous.
I cry out to my companions.
I'll call my flock before I go near.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶找落脚的地方
lines.en: I circle overhead looking for a perch.
I settle back into the grass.
Let me try this time.
I am diving down.
I fly after it from behind.
I am slow; it is fast.
From up high I can see clearly.
My wings ache a little.
It hides in the tree; I cannot follow.
I wait for it to come out.
A companion is beside me.
A little lower.
I will use my bubble.
One last try.
I have stopped in midair.
I am diving at it.
I blow a bubble.
The bubble drifts over and pops.
I swipe with a tiny claw.
That carried little force.
I blow another.
It swipes, and I fly off.
I circle its head.
My teeth are too soft to bite deep.
I tuck in among my flock to breathe.
I am small; I cannot win.
I blow one more bubble.
I land in the tree to catch my breath.
A small flock rises from the grass.

lines.zh: 我从数据里出现，落在草上
lines.en: I appear from data and land on the grass.
Plenty of flowers here; I like it.
The moment I appear, I hunt for food.
My wings still carry a glow.
I fly out with my companions.
I am on the plain; the breeze is soft.
I land in your shadow.
The grass is taller than I am.
I cry out to call my companions.
I am not grown, but I can fly.
I head for the food.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的泡泡就没了
lines.en: Fire comes near and my bubbles vanish.

lines.zh: 我在空中翻了个身，稳住了
lines.en: I flip in the air and recover.

lines.zh: 水淹过我，我扑腾着往上
lines.en: Water covers me; I flail upward.

lines.zh: 我被掀到树上，挂了一会儿
lines.en: I was flung into a tree and hung there.

lines.zh: 箭头擦掉了翅上一点光
lines.en: An arrowhead scraped the glow off my wing.
That force holds me in the air.
Hunger keeps me from flying.
In one flash, everything goes white.
No air; I fall.
